analysis: The trial succeeded with host-evaluated macro validation HR@10 of 0.5137, compared with the supplied original SASRec result of 0.505 (+0.0087). Category HR@10 was 0.575 for Movies_and_TV, 0.560 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.410 for Electronics, and 0.510 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remains the weakest category. The modest aggregate gain supports further investigation of multi-negative ranking, but this trial changed several components together, so it cannot establish which change helped. No test metrics were available. The host reported 231.17 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Trains four separately routed SASRec models with 128-item histories, 64-dimensional embeddings, two causal pre-normalized Transformer blocks, two attention heads, GELU feed-forward layers, and dropout 0.2. Replaces independent BCE with cross-entropy over one positive and 64 uniformly sampled negatives excluded from the user's training history; adds a learned item bias. Long histories sometimes use random earlier windows. Uses seed 42, AdamW at learning rate 0.001, gradient clipping, and BF16 when supported. Selects checkpoints using local validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties and early stopping. Writes per-category checkpoints, metadata, and a matching working/predict.py that loads the trained architecture and routes by dataset_name. Reads existing train/validation splits from GAGC_DATA_DIR and writes artifacts beneath the trial directory.
